verdict.rationale: Fathom advertises a 'Conversational meeting assistant' and 'search across calls' feature, and ships an official MCP server plus Claude/ChatGPT connectors that expose meeting data (transcripts, summaries) to AI assistants for natural-language querying. However, there's no first-party documentation describing a native in-app Q&A experience that explicitly returns answers with cited sources across full meeting history — the closest evidence is generic feature bullets and reliance on external AI assistants via MCP. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the conversational assistant's Q&A/search UX, evidence of source-citation behavior, and confirmation it searches the entire meeting history natively rather than via external MCP client.
